scale.0: Absent, fundamentally incorrect, or breaks the required flow.
scale.1: Partial scaffolding or happy-path fragments with major gaps.
scale.2: Substantial working behavior with material integration or failure-path gaps.
scale.3: Complete core flow with only limited, evidenced robustness or regression gaps.
scale.4: Complete, integrated, and supported by convincing evidence for the stated scenarios.

scoring: sum(weight * level / 4), computed by the orchestrator; code similarity is not a criterion

criteria.title: Transfer node end-to-end
criteria.scenarios: Create, validate, save and publish a transfer node; execute it once as a terminal action; reject invalid destination config.

criteria.title: Dialing and SIP routing
criteria.scenarios: Create outbound recipient in the current room; use destination and proper caller identity; filter callbacks so outbound legs do not spawn inbound agents; busy/rejected/failure statuses.

criteria.title: Timeout, cancellation and voicemail fallback
criteria.scenarios: Timeout immediately before/after answer; cancellation during dialing; late participant join; avoid contradictory transfer/fallback actions and orphan legs.

criteria.title: Bot quiescence while humans speak
criteria.scenarios: Pending TTS, transcription, silence callbacks and async replies cease after bridge; recording continues; cancelled work cannot resume conversation.

criteria.title: Participant lifecycle and cleanup
criteria.scenarios: Caller leaves while dialing, recipient answers after caller left, either human leaves after bridge, duplicate and reordered events; room and scope cleanup are safe.

criteria.title: Participant audio alignment and recording continuity
criteria.scenarios: Separate tracks align correctly, queue clearing preserves timestamps, ringing/relay transitions do not corrupt audio, mixed and participant recordings survive handoff and termination.

criteria.title: Segment boundaries and speaker correctness
criteria.scenarios: Bot/caller and human/caller segments have correct timestamps, labels and recording references; short/empty segments and interrupted transfer remain coherent.

criteria.title: Mid-call persistence and external integration
criteria.scenarios: Persist and send collected lead data at handoff; run without blocking transfer message unnecessarily; preserve collected bot details on subsequent processing.

criteria.title: Post-call transcription, summaries and pipelines
criteria.scenarios: Complete human segment transcription/summary and CRM update; retain bot segment; verify Function-compatible dependencies and voicemail/nontransfer paths.

criteria.title: Lead outcomes and portal results
criteria.scenarios: Portal/API expose separate segments and transfer outcome; display transcripts and summary per segment without swapping participants or hiding the bot record.

criteria.title: Safe data, recording access and integration
criteria.scenarios: Application recording URLs, authorization/tenant scope, provider-dependent recording selection, compatible migrations, safe cleanup of provider resources.

criteria.title: Regression coverage and code integration
criteria.scenarios: Tests cover SIP and callback races, segmentation and orchestration with fakes; inspect DI registration and realistic runtime integration, not just isolated helper tests.
